maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is mainly finished-vehicle transport freight for OEMs and dealers; repair services only support its own fleet and some outside fleets.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are automakers, dealers, auctions, rental and leasing companies, all private businesses paying for vehicle transport.

serial_acquirer.reason: Formed by combining nine established auto transport providers (Proficient Auto Logistics roll-up, with acquisitions highlighted); growth built through acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Trucking of finished vehicles is a freight service; OEMs can use other carriers, though scale and OEM relationships give some stickiness.

notes: Recognized as a 2024 roll-up of auto haulers; switching difficulty for OEM contracts is somewhat uncertain.
